name: Send a weekly Bounce Watch watchlist report to Slack

parameters.content:
## Send a weekly Bounce Watch watchlist report to Slack

Bounce Watch tells you what just happened at a company and when — funding, senior hires, new offices, customer wins and partnerships, each carrying its own date. What the API covers: bouncewatch.com/products/data-enrichment-api

Live alerts tell you about one company at a time. A weekly report tells you what the whole list did, and which watches have not earned their place.

### How it works

A Monday schedule collects everything the watchlist has queued since the last collection. That gives two things at once: the events themselves, and the state of every watch — when you set it up and when it last matched. A Settings node turns both into a single message, listing what moved and then naming the watches that have gone a long time without a match. The Slack node posts it as one message rather than one per event.

### Setup

1. Get an API key at bouncewatch.com/register/api. It is free, no card, and every new account starts with 2,500 credits. Paste it into the Bounce Watch credential.
2. Put a few companies on your watchlist first. Use the Bounce Watch node's Watch → Add operation, or add them from your Bounce Watch account.
3. Pick your Slack credential and choose the channel on the last node.

Collecting costs no credits. A watch with no matches is not evidence that the company was quiet — a watch set up this week has simply not had time yet.

### Customization tips

Move the schedule to Friday afternoon if you would rather review the week than open it. Send the same message to email instead by swapping the last node.

## Collect the week

Everything queued since the last collection.
Free to call.

## Post it

One message, not one per event.
Quiet watches are listed, not judged.
